name: Pixel Art: Character Full Body
description: Image preset for a character full body in the Pixel Art look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a full-body design view. Describe build, default outfit, signature accessory, and stance from the entity, then apply the style. Nothing cropped.
context_prompt: full-body view of the character head to toe, standing pose that shows silhouette and costume, feet on a simple ground plane, pixel art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited 16 to 32 colour palette, readable silhouette at low resolution, no anti-aliasing, deliberate dithering, single consistent light direction, high-contrast outline against the background
negative_prompt: smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, photorealistic, 3d render, mixed pixel sizes, text, watermark
